criteria.requirement: Implement inflect.scopes.clone(engine) and temporary_options(engine,*,classical=None,count=sentinel,gender=None). Clone preserves actual engine subtype, all custom definitions and options without mutable aliasing. Temporary scope uses completed atomic classical behavior, applies actual num/gender methods, yields original engine and restores all prior state values even on failed entry or body exceptions. Nested scopes restore their immediate parent; explicit count=None clears persistent count. Rule changes inside scope are rolled back. Do not promise internal-container identity or concurrency isolation.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
